component.name: Universal Office (Beta)
component.summary: Word, Excel and PowerPoint files with faithful rendering
Documentos do Word, planilhas do Excel e apresentações do PowerPoint com renderização fiel

description.p: Universal Office is an office suite that renders documents the way Microsoft Office does. One app, three editors, each with its own launcher:

ul.li: Universal Write — edits .docx and opens .doc and .odt: same line breaks, pagination, fonts and layout as Word; track changes, comments, document comparison, spell checking in Brazilian Portuguese, US English and Spanish (works offline); export to PDF, HTML, ODT and XPS
Universal Sheet — opens .xlsx, .xlsm and .xls: formulas, number formats, conditional formatting, charts and images; saves .xlsx and exports PDF, ODS, CSV, TSV, HTML, Markdown and XML Spreadsheet 2003
Universal Slides — opens .pptx and .ppt, with a slide show that plays animations and transitions

description.p: It uses the fonts installed on the system, with metric-compatible open fonts (Liberation, Carlito, Caladea) as fallback. This is a beta release: cell and slide editing are still in progress.

O Universal Office é uma suíte de escritório que renderiza os documentos como o Microsoft Office. Um app, três editores, cada um com o seu lançador: Universal Write (.docx, .doc, .odt), Universal Sheet (.xlsx, .xlsm, .xls) e Universal Slides (.pptx, .ppt). Esta é uma versão beta: a edição de células e de slides ainda está em andamento.
First beta of the desktop suite: Universal Write, Universal Sheet and Universal Slides in one app.
